dedupe_keys.name: reference packet optical network topology for edge to core transport telefonica

description: This Zenodo record holds a reference multi-layer hierarchical network topology that spans from access to core networks, designed for studies of next-generation 6G transport and published by Telefónica research staff with academic co-authors. Inspired by Telefónica's actual deployments in medium-sized countries in Europe and the Americas, it integrates IP and optical (DWDM) layers, with hierarchical levels of edge, aggregation, metro and core nodes and the links between them, and comes with guidelines for using it as an open benchmark for network design, optimisation and analysis, including traffic aggregation, latency, cost efficiency and AI-driven network management. Coverage: a synthetic country-scale operator network, not a real place; deposited on 19 August 2024. Format and access: the record is marked restricted on Zenodo, so the files are released on request to the depositors through the record page; the accompanying description is public; licence Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 as stated in the record. Caveats: access requires a request; the topology is stylised; no traffic or failure data are given. Simulation uses: benchmark network for capacity planning and optimisation of IP-over-DWDM transport and for resilience tests of multi-layer networks. Related records: the SEASON access-metro reference topology from the same authors is openly downloadable, and SNDlib gives other benchmark networks.
